additional_resources.notes: Adds a concrete citation-audit method to existing GEO advice. The 15 prompts, three runs, 25 outreach targets and 30-day schedule are example planning choices, not ranking requirements or guarantees. SE Ranking, Ahrefs, Semrush and Gong numerical claims were not independently verified; correlations do not establish causes. OpenAI search/training crawler separation checked against official crawler documentation. The referral UTM assertion is retained as author advice; the cited publisher FAQ redirected to unrelated content during verification.

curation.reason: New repeatable buyer-prompt baseline and citation-versus-recommendation measurements; link once instead of repeating existing evidence, review-profile and crawl-access advice.

deduplication_policy: Compare the whole repository, including tools, research sources, MCP integrations and destination identities. Normalize www, redirects, alternate names and homepage/submission routes. Keep independent GitHub repositories separate. Store additional source references against an existing destination rather than creating another guide listing.

curation_policy.scope: Apply to all existing resources and all future user-supplied posts.
curation_policy.relevance: Include usable SEO research, technical work, content improvement, measurement, or a destination with a plausible product-discovery, editorial, publishing or submission role. A high DR claim alone is not relevance.
curation_policy.deduplication: Compare the whole repository, including tools, research sources, MCP integrations and destination identities. Normalize www, redirects, alternate names and homepage/submission routes. Keep independent GitHub repositories separate. Store additional source references against an existing destination rather than creating another guide listing.
curation_policy.articles: Use a descriptive title, original article/post link and a short takeaway. Do not copy the full article. Establish the topic before adding it to the guide.
curation_policy.updates: Update an existing entry only with useful new facts, recovered practical content, checked submission details or source provenance.
curation_policy.evidence: Separate official guidance, historical trial evidence, patent descriptions, author interpretation and unverified outcomes. A patent or leaked field name does not establish a deployed ranking rule.
curation_policy.withholding: Keep inaccessible implementation details, pure promotion, repeated basic advice, ambiguous destinations, unsupported guarantees and poor-fit platforms in the source register rather than the main guide.
curation_policy.source_preservation: Retain original post URLs, authors, dates, list positions, supplied-text coverage and remaining access gaps. Partial threads must remain labelled partial.
